items.headline: Gale Watch issued September 21 at 1:04PM EDT until September 25 at 7:00AM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds 15 to 25
kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas 5 to 8 ft expected. For the
Gale Watch, northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt
and seas 9 to 14 ft possible.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Fenwick Island DE to Chincoteague
VA out 20 NM and Coastal waters from Chincoteague to Parramore
Island VA out 20 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 6 PM this evening to
6 PM EDT Tuesday. For the Gale Watch, from Tuesday evening
through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
